locator.title: Работаю в Level: почему купил квартиру от нашей компании
locator.lead: История, как я купил квартиру в Левел Групп после шести лет работы в компании
locator.caption: Мой новый дом, Левел Причальный, находится в районе Хорошёво-Мневники

nearest_text_before.text: Я выбрал этот дом не просто потому, что работаю в компании. Дело в том, что я сам проверяю наши объекты и на 100% уверен в их качестве. Но это далеко не единственная причина. В статье расскажу, что ещё мне понравилось в Левел Причальный.

image_reading: A low-angle wide view shows a landscaped residential courtyard enclosed by brick-and-glass high-rise buildings under a clear blue sky.
Young trees, shrubs, and grass are the main naturally movable elements; benches, play structures, paths, façades, and the blue courtyard surface are stationary.
The upward composition emphasizes the scale and finished character of the two central towers while the greenery makes the courtyard feel inhabited and comfortable.
analysis.article_context: This article image introduces Sergey's new home, Level Prichalny, after he explains that his professional experience gave him confidence in the developer's construction quality. The courtyard view makes the residential complex tangible and leads into his reasons for choosing it as a place to live, beginning with its location by the river.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: The completed, landscaped residential complex supports Sergey's confidence that Level Prichalny is a high-quality and comfortable place to call home.
structured_intent.primary_action: A gentle breeze passes continuously through the visible courtyard foliage.
structured_intent.terminal_state: By the last frame, the breeze has softened to a faint residual sway in the leaves while the residential towers remain fully visible.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The courtyard remains a calm, welcoming residential setting, with the buildings retaining their stable and imposing presence.

models.scene_plan: For the full five-second fixed shot, a moderate breeze begins immediately in the left-side foliage, passes across the central tree and lower shrubs, then gradually weakens. Movement stays restrained and physically coherent, preserving the architectural emphasis. In the final frames, the greenery remains in a small residual sway while both central towers are fully visible and unchanged.
models.positive_prompt: A gentle breeze travels through the courtyard trees and shrubs from left to right, bending the leaves in a smooth wave before they ease into a soft residual sway by the final frame. The camera remains fixed and the towers stay clearly visible throughout.

models.scene_plan: Across five seconds, use an even, light breeze rather than a single gust: fine leaf motion starts across the foreground shrubs, becomes most readable in the central tree, and tapers naturally near the end. The fixed camera protects the strong upward architectural composition. The endpoint is a calm courtyard with only gentle movement in the highest leaves and the towers still dominant.
models.positive_prompt: Keep the camera fixed as a light breeze steadily ripples through the courtyard foliage, moving across the greenery and gradually calming until only the upper leaves sway gently in the final frame; the residential towers remain continuously visible.

models.scene_plan: Fit the motion to four seconds with one focused breeze pulse. It starts at once in the low greenery, crosses the central tree at a restrained amplitude, and subsides without becoming fully static. The camera stays fixed. The last frame shows faint fluttering at the leaf tips, with the high-rise buildings unobstructed and unchanged.
models.positive_prompt: Fixed camera. A brief soft breeze moves through the courtyard shrubs and central tree in one smooth left-to-right ripple, easing to a faint leaf flutter by the final frame while the towers remain fully visible.
